    • readInbox

      private static void readInbox(net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc)
      Runs the /swordai commands left in swordai/inbox.txt as if they had been typed, and removes the file. That is how it is started, asked for its status and stopped with nobody at the keyboard: a script writes the file, and what the commands say goes to the game's log. Only its own commands are taken from there, and only while a world is open.

    • keyedPassFailed

      public static void keyedPassFailed(RuntimeException error)
      Drawing the agent's picture in a pass of its own went wrong. It is not tried again: the game goes back to one picture per frame, the keyed one, which is what the agent needs.

    • skinBlindsTheAgent

      static void skinBlindsTheAgent(String grabs)
      With the opponent's own skin shown, the agent's picture has no opponent in it: the picture it is handed is not the keyed one. Showing the skin is switched off, here and in the config, so that it does not come back with the next start; the agent then sees again at once.
      Parameters:
      grabs - what the frame grabber has to say about the pictures it took meanwhile
